text: Its old owner cheated. Like… a lot.
So Riot didn't just ban his account. It banned his hardware.
So he did the most normal thing ever. He sold it.
Meet Leo. Found a great deal. Never cheated once.
He saved up. He did everything right… and paid for someone else's mistake.
Hey… every like takes one day off my sentence. And subscribe… it gets lonely in here.
How? Your CPU has a tiny vault with a secret key.
New Windows? Same key. New account? Same key.
Good news: Riot says hardware bans last four months, max.
Plot twist? Riot doesn't fully buy Leo's story.
